name: column-selection
author: lumine-code
description: Create rectangular selections across lines by dragging.
backgroundTips: You can keep rectangular selection on for repeated mouse gestures with {{ 'column-selection:sticky' | keystroke }}

mouseButton.title: Mouse button
mouseButton.description: The mouse button that starts a column selection. Choose None to use only sticky or picker mode.

selectKey.title: Select key
selectKey.description: The modifier required to start column selection.

statusBar.title: Status bar icon
statusBar.description: Show the column selection mode indicator in the status bar.
